subject.title: [Feature]: Expose an inbound non-message event hook to external channel plugins (e.g. reactions)

question: Should external channel plugins surface non-message activity through the existing system-event/inbound-runner APIs, or should OpenClaw add a new public channel event hook or adapter contract?
rationale: Current main exposes partial primitives, but choosing a plugin SDK event surface affects third-party compatibility and overlaps with an open inbound_activity hook proposal.

options.title: Document Current System-Event Path
options.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events, document the recipe for channel plugins, and add code only where that recipe proves insufficient.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow Event Hook
options.body: Define a typed plugin SDK hook or adapter for non-message inbound activity and coordinate it with the related inbound_activity PR before merging an implementation.

options.title: Require A Concrete Plugin Sketch
options.body: Ask for a minimal Zoho Cliq plugin sketch showing exactly why system events and runChannelInboundEvent cannot satisfy the use case.

recommendation.title: Document Current System-Event Path
recommendation.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events, document the recipe for channel plugins, and add code only where that recipe proves insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared SDK/channel builder work and co-authorship on current central-file provenance make steipete the best available owner for the SDK direction choice.
